title: The Fourth Key Holder
summary: The holders of the four Ancient Keys gather at the Ancient Treasure Trove on the Ancient Battlefield. Shi Kun of the Demon Rock Dynasty has put a bounty of a million Nirvana Pills on Lin Dong, and Hong Lie of the Primordial Dynasty says he has found a powerful ally. Lin Dong arrives with Little Flame and Little Mink as the fourth key holder. Shi Kun attacks him to avenge his brother Shi Xuan, and Lin Dong holds his own with Yuan Essence Power and the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger. You Qing stops the fight, and the four keys open the treasure, the ruins of a vast ancient sect. Little Mink leads Lin Dong to the pill chamber, where Yan Sen and others are fighting over the pills. Little Mink spots a Life and Death Reincarnation Pill that could rebuild his body, and Lin Dong decides to take it.
events: Shi Kun and Hong Lie wait at the treasure; Shi Kun has offered a million Nirvana Pills for Lin Dong.
Lin Dong arrives with Little Flame as the fourth Ancient Secret Key holder.
Shi Kun, Two Yuan Nirvana peak, attacks Lin Dong over his brother Shi Xuan's death.
Lin Dong fights back with Yuan Essence Power and the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger.
You Qing and Hong Lie call a halt, and the four keys open the Ancient Treasure Trove.
The groups split up; Hong Lie's hooded ally has an aura Lin Dong finds familiar.
In the pill chamber Little Mink spots the Life and Death Reincarnation Pill, which could rebuild his body.
Lin Dong and Little Flame go after the pill.
cultivation: Lin Dong is One Yuan Nirvana and a Heaven Symbol Master. Shi Kun is at the peak of Two Yuan Nirvana.
